_comment: Starter drill catalogue for the read-only `drills` collection. The project documents require a drill library but enumerate no drills; this set covers every metric the CV pipeline measures. Seed via scripts/seed_drills.js (Admin SDK) — client writes are blocked by security rules.

free_throw_series.name: Free Throw Series
free_throw_series.instructions: Stand at the free throw line. Phone on a stand at the side, both you and the basket in frame. Take 20 free throws at your own pace. A tone confirms each detected shot.

spot_shooting.name: Spot Shooting — 5 Positions
spot_shooting.instructions: Take 5 shots from each of 5 spots around the arc (corners, wings, top). Move to the next spot after 5 attempts. Keep both yourself and the basket in frame.

quick_release.name: Quick Release Catch-and-Shoot
quick_release.instructions: Self-pass or have a partner pass the ball. Shoot as quickly as possible after the catch. Focus on lowering your release time while keeping accuracy above 50%.

stationary_dribble.name: Stationary Dribble — Right/Left
stationary_dribble.instructions: Stand facing the camera. Dribble with your right hand for 30 seconds, then your left hand for 30 seconds. Keep the ball below waist height and your eyes up.

speed_dribble.name: Speed Dribble Burst
speed_dribble.instructions: Dribble as fast as you can control for 3 bursts of 20 seconds, resting 10 seconds between bursts. The app measures your dribble frequency (bounces per second).

reaction_sprint_start.name: Audio Cue Reaction Start
reaction_sprint_start.instructions: Stand ready in an athletic stance facing the camera. When you hear the beep, explode into a sprint start. The app measures the time from the beep to your first movement. 8 repetitions.

reaction_defensive_slide.name: Reaction Defensive Slide
reaction_defensive_slide.instructions: Start in a defensive stance. On each beep, slide two steps in the opposite direction to your last slide. The app records your reaction time to each cue. 10 cues.

combo_dribble_shoot.name: Combo: Dribble Into Jump Shot
combo_dribble_shoot.instructions: Start at half court in frame. Speed dribble to the arc and pull up for a jump shot. Walk back and repeat 10 times. Measures dribbles, shots, and release time together.
